data.name: Glencore
data.sa_presence: Major SA coal producer (Optimum, Goedgevonden); one of the world's largest third-party iron ore traders (70M+ tons/yr); active in chrome/ferrochrome through Merafe JV
data.notable_activity: Glencore's metals trading division recorded record adjusted EBIT of $1.57 billion in H1 2025; active bidder for SA coal assets including Optimum Coal mines

data.name: Trafigura
data.sa_presence: Active trader of SA thermal coal through Richards Bay Coal Terminal; entered bidding for Optimum Coal (Gupta-linked mines); non-ferrous metals traders recorded record profits in FY2025
data.notable_activity: Exploring SA coal mine acquisitions; expanding metals trading footprint to compete with Glencore

data.name: Vitol / Noble Resources
data.sa_presence: Bidder for SA Optimum Coal; acquired Singapore-based Noble Resources (energy and industrial raw materials trader) to expand hard commodities desk
data.notable_activity: Hired ex-Glencore and Trafigura iron ore traders in 2024 to build out metals trading; actively growing SA market presence

data.name: SMJ SA
data.sa_presence: SA-based; connects mines and producers in South Africa, Botswana, and Zimbabwe to international buyers; develops offtake agreements with bulk commodity producers
data.notable_activity: Active pit-to-port facilitation for chrome and coal; focus on Southern African cross-border supply chains

data.name: CSA Commodities
data.sa_presence: SA-based; trades thermal coal and metals both domestically and internationally; provides integrated pit-to-port management and vessel top-ups for coal exports
data.notable_activity: Specialises in export logistics coordination alongside commodity trading; active at Richards Bay Coal Terminal

data.name: AfriResources
data.sa_presence: 100% Black-owned SA bulk commodity trading company; exports coal, chrome, and manganese; serves both export and domestic markets
data.notable_activity: BBBEE-compliant trader appealing to transformation-sensitive buyers and state-linked procurement; growing export footprint

data.name: Meidos Mining Group
data.sa_presence: One of Africa's leading exporters of chrome, coal, and manganese; operates 3 wash plants in SA; exported 588,000 metric tons in 2023
data.notable_activity: Vertically integrated processing capability (wash plants); growing export volumes year-on-year

data.name: Makhoba Commodities
data.sa_presence: SA-based bulk commodity sourcing and trading; sources from SA mines and connects to domestic and export buyers
data.notable_activity: Active in multiple bulk mineral categories; positions as a sourcing and logistics bridge for international buyers
